Powered by AI, it crafts viral hooks, full scripts, and suggests trending hashtags specifically for social media creators. Boost your reach on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts with less effort and more creativity.

posts.name: Akir
posts.tagline: Persistent project context for AI chats without memory loss
posts.description: Tired of Claude & ChatGPT losing project context? Akir is an AI workspace designed to build cumulative knowledge. Upload documents, start chats, and use our persistent Knowledge Ledger to commit verified facts. Every future thread starts with all your context already in the room - saving you from briefing the AI from scratch. Run side-by-side model comparisons, branch threads, and keep your workspace structured and organised. Built for devs, researchers, and creators.

posts.name: TheDecisionHub Launch
posts.tagline: Ranked options + Reddit sentiment for any purchase.
posts.description: Most comparison tools give you a generic listicle or just send you to Amazon. TheDecisionHub structures the answer like a decision, three ranked options with scores, pros/cons, a tradeoff matrix, and real Reddit community quotes. The thing I kept running into was Googling "best X" and getting 10 affiliate blogs recommending the same products with no real tradeoff explanation. TheDecisionHub is my attempt to fix that, one query, structured output, done.

posts.name: Fitness Challenge
posts.tagline: Fitness challenges made social, competitive & fun
posts.description: Fitness Challenge Club makes it effortless to organize fitness competitions with friends, family, or coworkers. • No account needed, jump in instantly. • Built-in group chat right next to the leaderboard. • AI walking opponents, start competing immediately, even solo • Compete on steps, calories, distance, flights climbed, or Apple Health Rings. • Completely free, no fees, no subscriptions, no ads. iOS only. Privacy-first, Apple Sign-In keeps your email private. Use it fully anonymously.

posts.name: TintenAI
posts.tagline: Build a no-code AI assistant for your website in minutes

Connect a Shopify or WooCommerce catalog, customize branding and tone, trigger automated workflows, and track conversations with built-in analytics. From salons and clinics to online stores, TintenAI turns everyday chats into bookings, quotes, and sales.

posts.name: Komuniteti
posts.tagline: Where buildings become communities.
posts.description: Komuniteti modernizes building management by connecting administrators, residents, businesses, and service professionals in one platform. It replaces fragmented communication and paper-based processes with real-time notifications, issue reporting, payment reminders, polls, document management, QR-based resident registration, and a local services marketplace, improving transparency, efficiency, and community engagement.

posts.name: Pets Therapy - Desktop Pets
posts.tagline: Cute pixel art pets that live on your desktop 🐶🐱🐕🐇🐈🐹🐩
posts.description: Bring your desktop to life with cute pixel pets that walk, nap, eat, fly and play while you work. Pets Therapy brings back the magic of classic desktop companions with 75+ adorable pets, including cats, dogs, capybaras, llamas and more. Create your own tiny pixel world on Mac or Windows with animated companions that add a little joy and personality to your everyday computer experience.

posts.name: dyeary
posts.tagline: Say it, and we feel it.
posts.description: dyeary is a voice-first journal. Talk for a minute; it writes the entry and senses how you felt. Entries become clean summaries that quote your own words, a year-long mood calendar, and life areas like Work and Love that fill in as you talk. No checkout, no LLM, deterministic replayable evidence. See what it catches in one command, no token or repo: npx mergewarden demo. Built after scanning 2,204 merged agent PRs: zero declared their scope. MIT.
